judged_text: totalPages uses Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1, producing a phantom page when user_count is an exact multiple of limit, and showingLast on that page. An admin paging a 100-member group with limit 50 sees "1/3"; clicking next lands on an empty third page where next is still not disabled, and the previous "showingLast" guard never fires on the real last page when offset math drifts.

record.issue_text: [ADVISORY] totalPages uses Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1, producing a phantom page when user_count is an exact multiple of limit, and showingLast on that page. An admin paging a 100-member group with limit 50 sees "1/3"; clicking next lands on an empty third page where next is still not disabled, and the previous "showingLast" guard never fires on the real last page when offset math drifts.

adjudication.rationale: In `admin-group.js.es6`, `totalPages` is computed as `Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1`. When `user_count` is an exact multiple of `limit` (e.g. 100/50), this yields 3 instead of 2, creating a phantom last page. The `next` action uses `offset = Math.min(offset + limit, user_count)`, so on the “real” last page it advances `offset` to `user_count` (e.g. 100), and `Group.findMembers` then requests `offset=100`, which the server will return as an empty page (`limit 50 offset 100`). Because `showingLast` is based on `currentPage == totalPages`, it will be false on the real last page, allowing navigation into the empty phantom page.
